item.title: What I love about Django
item.description:
📝 HEROKU_SLUG_COMMIT return response If there's one tool that I think the median Django developer should take more advantage of, it's middlewares. Implicit change tracking: define handle_<field>_change and it runs whenever that field changes — no signal, no registration. py class Email(BaseModel): # Implicit change tracking: define handle_<field>_change and BaseModel # invokes it whenever that field actually changes.
🔗 Read more: https://buttondown.com/blog/what-i-love-about-django

item.title: Let's all meet up in the Y2K
item.description:
📝 I’d come from graphic design agency Form, but wanted somewhere to do bigger web projects with other likeminded souls. This was before browser CSS support came of age, so it was all table layouts with single pixel spacer gifs: good times. I’m pretty sure this is another photo from Morgan’s desk when it was one island away from his first desk.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.gingerbeardman.com/2026/08/06/lets-all-meet-up-in-the-y2k/
